ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with an approximate 1.2:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white zones situated medially and laterally on both lobes, bisected by a vertical black axial corridor. The trailing edge is bounded by a black margin of varying width (5-20 pixels) that narrows towards the tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped notch; calculated angle of approximately 32 degrees with a bounding-box depth extending roughly 10% of the fluke's total vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary with high-frequency peaks (2-5 pixel amplitude) along the right lobe; the left lobe displays lower-frequency, smoother undulating topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-sweeping curve exhibiting slight convexity from the notch, transitioning to concavity at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular dark-ringed anomalies concentrated on the right lobe distal quadrant; multiple isolated circular spots distributed within the white pigmentation of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel streaks oriented diagonally across the white pigmentation of the left lobe and lower inner right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular pitting and structural scarring consistent with prior epibiont colonization, most prominent on the right distal margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple 'ocellus-like' circular markers (dark center within white field) on the lower inner quadrants of both lobes.
